name: Victim's Body
description: Adrian Cole found in the library. No signs of struggle. Death caused by poison.

name: Bottle of Red Wine
description: Vintage red wine bottle beside the body. Originally a gift from Victor Hayes. Laced with poison.

name: Poison Sachets
description: Empty poison sachets found in the kitchen trash. First suggests Sarah, who worked in the kitchen.

name: Fingerprint on Desk
description: Partial print on Adrian's desk. Ultimately a distraction.

name: Handwritten Note
description: Note from Adrian to Victor asking him to settle things in the library after dinner. Points at Victor at first.

name: CCTV Footage
description: Camera captures only the lower body. Someone carries the red wine bottle toward the library. Size 10 shoes. No face visible.

name: Size 10 Footprints
description: Size 10 footprints near the library. Not enough alone to identify anyone.

name: Sarah's White-Wine Statement
description: Sarah remembers she poured Adrian a glass of WHITE wine, not red. Adrian carried white wine into the library.

name: Emma Entered the Kitchen
description: After the sachets are found, Sarah recalls that Emma slipped into the kitchen after Victor left. Emma admits it only when confronted.

name: Bottle Wrapped in Table Cloth
description: Sarah and Ethan independently remember Emma walking toward the library carrying something wrapped in a white table cloth. Ethan thought it was books.

name: Emma's Size 10 Shoes
description: After the CCTV is reviewed, sizing confirms Emma also wears size 10 — the shoes on camera aren't proof of Victor.
